except ImportError:
    print("Pandas is not available. Creating a simple CSV version instead...")
    
    import csv
    
    # Read the original CSV and write anonymized version
    with open('/tmp/april-attendance-data.csv', 'r') as infile:
        reader = csv.reader(infile)
        header = next(reader)
        
        # Create mapping for employee names
        employees = set()
        rows = list(reader)
        for row in rows:
            employees.add(row[1])  # Employee Name column
            
        employee_mapping = {name: f'Employee {chr(65 + i)}' for i, name in enumerate(sorted(employees))}
        
        # Write anonymized CSV
        with open('/workspace/anonymized-attendance.csv', 'w', newline='') as outfile:
            writer = csv.writer(outfile)
            writer.writerow(header)
            
            for row in rows:
                new_row = row.copy()
                new_row[1] = employee_mapping[row[1]]  # Replace employee name
                writer.writerow(new_row)
                
    print("Anonymized attendance data saved to /workspace/anonymized-attendance.csv")
    print("\nEmployee mapping:")
    for original, pseudonym in employee_mapping.items():
        print(f"{original} -> {pseudonym}")
